payload.text: The Bellows. The Works draw breath. Mind the pressure. And please, do mind the duck: it has been here longer than you have, and it knows where the tea is kept.

The Bellows. The Works draw breath. Mind the pressure.
[softly] Something is alive in the old refinery. Listen. Experiment. Find your way down.
[softly] Something is alive in the old refinery. Listen. Experiment. Find your way down.
The Bellows. The Works draw breath. Mind the pressure.
The Rot Gardens. Where the refinery digests. Do not linger.
The Rot Gardens. Where the refinery digests. Do not linger.
The Drowned Cisterns. The veins run cold. Something large keeps them company.
The Kiln Heart. The heart still burns. It would rather you did not.
The Drowned Cisterns. The veins run cold. Something large keeps them company.
The Kiln Heart. The heart still burns. It would rather you did not.
The gut. Everything here is growing, rotting, or making up its mind, and the air is flammable.
The veins. Several hundred tons of water and one very large tenant who never pays rent.
The heart. Hot, loud, and under the impression that it is a volcano.
Drain the Sunken Leviathan.
[whispers] The Sunken Leviathan. It drains poorly.
The Kiln Colossus. Stopping it is the whole point.
Bring down the Kiln Colossus.
The sump falls still.
The kiln is cold.
First, a little powder.
The Unreasonable Bell and Tea Engine.
A broken coupling.
The knot is the fuse.
Percussive maintenance.
Downhill, briskly.
The tollgate is stuck.
The spring lets go.
Six dominoes and a wound spring.
[dryly] Please mind the duck.
A marble of some urgency.
The second fuse.
[dryly] This is probably enough heat.
A most electrifying tea bag.
Gravity gets the last word.
Tea is served. The bell is yours.
The magnet has opinions.
The descent gate needs its brass bell. Pull the crank to begin.
[sighs] A slight technical difficulty.
Collect the brass bell at the receiver, then carry it to the descent gate.
Shoot the priming pan under the floor.
Return to the crank. Press Use to recharge the engine.
Kick the Persuader hanging from the ceiling.
The slow match reaches the priming pan.
Pour water through the grate into the duck’s bath.
The percussion cap fires.
The clockwork knocker gives the Persuader a whack.
Engine recharged. Pull the crank to try again.
Bell and Tea Engine: The fuse fizzled out at the cracked coupling.
You dissolved.
Bell and Tea Engine: The tollgate is jammed shut.
Bell and Tea Engine: The downpipe is clogged.
Dissolved by acid. Very clean work, chemically speaking.
Acid reduced the alchemist to a smaller argument.
[dryly] Tagged by an acid glob. The glob was smug about it.
A caustic lob made its point.
An acid slime turned a hug into a hazard.
You were blown apart.
An explosive barrel fulfilled its destiny nearby.
Acid slime contact. Sticky, sour, final.
You were taken.
Barrel chemistry: one, alchemist: zero.
A bat cashed in the smallest possible assassination.
Bitten out of the air by a flying nuisance.
The fuse had one joke.
You burned.
A bomber slime chose mutual destruction. You were not consulted.
Burned to death while still technically on fire.
Stopped, dropped, and forgot the rolling part.
The Kiln died loudly and took you as a footnote.
[dryly] Victory explosion. Timing could improve.
The Kiln Colossus served you extra crispy.
Molten rock, express delivery.
You were crushed.
The Kiln Colossus stamped your ticket.
A furnace with fists ended the expedition.
The current took you.
Electrocuted. The sparks were not applause.
Exploded by local cave policy.
Conducted electricity better than good judgment.
A blast made a persuasive counterargument.
Fire solved the alchemist problem.
You froze.
Cooked by open flame. The robe was not rated for this.
Frozen stiff by a hostile frostbolt.
Put on ice by something with aim.
Rock, thrown by golem. Case closed.
A golem skipped the warning and threw punctuation.
A golem explained gravity with its fists.
Flattened by stone with an opinion.
Gunpowder remembered it was gunpowder.
Powder line became a full stop.
Hostile debris introduced itself at speed.
Hit by cave mail, postage due.
A hostile fireball delivered kiln-to-door service.
Fireball to the face. Elegant? No. Effective? Yes.
You fell.
Killed by impact. The floor was technically uninvolved.
Physics submitted the final blow.
You melted.
Attempted geology by immersion.
[dryly] The Leviathan surfaced for a snack.
[dryly] Lava bath. Zero stars, no refund.
Eaten by the problem in the pool.
The Leviathan brushed past and took most of you with it.
Grazed by a basement-sized appetite.
You were swept away.
The Leviathan threw the pool at you.
Struck down.
Defeated by high-velocity plumbing.
Lightning found the shortest path through you.
Self-administered lightning. Bold, brief.
[dryly] Oiled, then lit. Classic wizard candle behavior.
Turned into a lesson about accelerants.
A Powder Mage made the cave throw things at you.
Telekinetic debris: local, organic, fatal.
A Rillback came out of the water with its mouth open.
The pool had teeth after all.
Flattened by a Rillback flailing on dry stone.
You were struck down.
A stranded Rillback thrashed and you were in the way.
The undergrowth lashed back.
A Rootloper whipped its roots through you.
Own spell, own crater.
Self-inflicted explosion. The wand technically worked.
A slime bounced, bit, and somehow won.
You succumbed.
[dryly] Slime contact: humiliating, but documented.
A status effect finished the job quietly.
The aftereffect got the last word.
You were scalded.
Scalded by a pressure vent. The gauge did warn you.
Steamed open by the works.
You were poisoned.
The Stone Maw closed its jaw. The cave digests slowly.
Swallowed by a mouth that looked like the floor.
Poison did the paperwork slowly.
Toxic sludge won the debate.
You died.
Cause of death: alchemy happened.
The caves decline to specify. Suspicious.
The descent wrote the report in dust.
The Weaver got its revenge.
The Weaver filed you under caught.
You were pinned.
The Weaver brought teeth. The web was optional.
Pinned by the Weaver. No corkboard survived.
The Weaver threaded the needle through you.
Wet, shocked, and briefly educational.
Self-inflicted electrocution in water. Excellent conductivity, poor planning.
[softly] The Kiln is quiet.
[softly] The Kiln is quiet.
You fell in the Bellows.
[warmly] The Colossus is scrap, the Kiln is cooling, and somewhere a kettle is finally allowed to boil.
You left the Bellows early.

Left the descent unharmed, which the Works will count as a draw.

Left the descent with the ledger open and the kettle still warm.
A new case on the rack: The Ember Case. Choose it at your next descent.
A new case on the rack: The Rime Case. Choose it at your next descent.
A new case on the rack: The Storm Case. Choose it at your next descent.
The material sandbox. Nothing here can hurt you, much.
